headline.title: Held-out test subsample (120 questions): Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, hybrid retrieval, all fixes

tables.title: Retrieval methods (FinanceBench dev, section chunks)
tables.description: LLM-free: each FinanceBench dev question is run against its own document and scored against the human-labeled evidence pages.

tables.title: Chunking strategy (FinanceBench dev)
tables.description: Section- and table-aware chunks vs fixed 512-token chunks, same retrieval methods. Fixed chunks are about twice as long on average, so each hit covers more of a labeled page.

tables.title: Agent components (62-question dev slice)
tables.description: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. Removing the XBRL facts tool, or the number verification and citation self-check.

tables.title: Targeted fixes from error analysis (62-question dev slice)
tables.description: Each row turns one fix off. Deltas are the cost of removing that fix.

tables.title: Models (20-question smoke slice)
tables.description: Same agent and settings (dedupe off, as when the Groq run was recorded for the first CI baseline). Local model latency is measured on a laptop GPU shared with other jobs.
